markers.reading: The party begins aboard Vindristjarna in the hot afternoon.

evidence.quote: it's been about 15 min, maybe a little less
Delwath: Well, Delwath is standing, casting the spell, which takes 10 min, like muttering and sort of—
Delwath: So I wanted to give—help—Kenzo some time to get situated and visible, right? Right. And then, so yeah, it's probably been—it's probably been about—probably about 15 or 20 min. Yeah.
DM: Okay, so at this moment the scry finishes, targeting Kenzo clone, and this scry—scrying eye appears.

markers.reading: The party settles for the night; morning waking and completed long-rest credit establish overnight passage.

evidence.quote: So you settle in for the night.

DM: And then, as you jolt awake, you no longer have any sense of where the jade is. You still remember the location of the jungle in the cliff where it was, but you can no longer sense it as you sit down for breakfast in the morning.
DM: You just long. You just finished a long rest.

duration.basis: Long-rest convention for the explicitly completed overnight rest

markers.reading: Kenzo enters a dream of the jade traveling out to sea during the overnight rest.

evidence.quote: DM: Kenzo, you have a dream of the jade. Jade you're flying to is cracking and bubbling, turning into a mist that floats out of this red sandstone cave, drifting above the jungle. Everything's dark and still until a strong wind sweeps up, and the jade mist swirls and blows across the canopy. You're swept with it and you watch the canopy pass below you, and you see the twinkling of the ocean waves crashing below you, despite the clear skies and seeming lack of winds.

DM: In the light of the waxing crescent moon. And then you're quickly blown offshore, swooping past mangroves and over the shoals, your sense of time and distance distorted in the greenscape—dreamscape—until—

markers.note: Moonlight and distorted dream time do not measure adventure elapsed time.

markers.reading: Kenzo wakes and breakfast resumes in the morning, with no remaining directional sense of the jade.

evidence.quote: DM: And then, as you jolt awake, you no longer have any sense of where the jade is. You still remember the location of the jungle in the cliff where it was, but you can no longer sense it as you sit down for breakfast in the morning.

DM: You stand there for.

markers.reading: The second Radiance lasts ten minutes while the colossus tries to smash the staircase.

evidence.quote: DM: And it's seems to have like pulled itself up a little bit, so it can almost now reach—with how big it is and how like standing it is—it can almost—it can basically reach the bottom of the staircase now. markers.reading: Vindristjarna flies onward for the next few hours and halts above the former jade cave.

evidence.quote: DM: Over the next—the course of the next few hours, you fly on Vindristjarna until you reach what looks like the—the—so you can see where—from where you are now. These—this is like jungle with these red sandstone cliffs, and you can see—

yamlCheck.dateAnchor: May 14 is independently established by the May 12 plus two days statement and explicit sunset date; year 1749 comes from YAML. Two completed overnights reach May 16.
yamlCheck.explanation: May 14 afternoon through May 16 arrival, with completed overnight passage on each of the two nights. Dream geography has no additional calendar passage. The initially proposed early rest and next-morning combat are replaced by fighting before the second overnight.
